title: The squat jump,
learned.
clips.lede: A person squat-jumping on a phone video became this G1. It's the policy, not an animation. Push it.
clips.video: One phone clip: two squat jumps.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab on 36 variants of the clip, with pushes during training.

title: The front kick,
learned.
clips.lede: Two front kicks, turned into a policy that balances on one leg through each. Push it mid-kick.
clips.video: One phone clip: two front kicks.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab on 36 variants of the clip, with pushes during training.

title: The squat,
learned.
clips.lede: Two slow squats. The policy follows the reference within a few degrees and keeps its feet planted when pushed.
clips.video: One phone clip: two bodyweight squats.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab on the clip itself, with pushes during training.

facts.l: mean joint error to the reference

title: The lakeside run,
on the spot.
clips.lede: A runner filmed along a lakeside road. The G1 runs the gait in place.
clips.video: Pavel Danilyuk's clip (Pexels License); the forward travel is taken out.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab on 36 variants of the clip, warm-started from the squat-jump tracker.

facts.l: of clean runs pass the clip's spec (3 of 13 key moments required)
of runs on held-out variants pass their own spec

credit.text: Pavel Danilyuk, "A Man Wearing Sunglasses Running in the Street", Pexels

title: The dance,
learned.
clips.lede: A dance on a phone video. Watch the robot learn it attempt by attempt, then push the trained policy.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab on 36 variants of the clip, 1,500 iterations.

facts.l: of clean runs pass the clip's spec (3 of 7 key moments required)
of runs on held-out variants pass their own spec

clips.caveat: Stays up and tracks the moves, but passes 3 of 9 key moments
